summary: Smallest approved React + Elysia/Bun + real PostgreSQL + authenticated native WS tracer bullet implemented with TDD (partial test-first ordering recorded honestly). Mode A: host Bun 1.4.4 + Docker PostgreSQL 16.15-alpine (5433) with 56/56 integration tests passing. Mode B: fresh worktree at separate project c1b with Docker-only images (ports 5174/3001/5434) and the same 56/56 tests running inside a container. Join, rating/poll with optional comment, atomic commit, stable idempotency receipts, close/submit ordering, facilitator aggregate without nickname/comment, CORS/WS origin contract, grant isolation, reconnect resync and restart persistence verified. C1-15 is PARTIAL: production build and deep-link reload verified, real-browser interaction NOT RUN (no browser automation available).
